metricDefinition.responseMs: second trusted event to second readyState; fixed 2000 ms inter-action delay is excluded
metricDefinition.rscDurationMedianMs: median duration of captured RSC requests intersecting the same second-action window
metricDefinition.authTotalMedianMs: median of all captured auth_total server spans in each diagnostic observation
metricDefinition.reactCommitWindow: react_commit count and actualDuration sum whose performance timestamp falls within the second-action window
metricDefinition.requestWindowCount: all captured requests whose lifetime intersects the second-action window

finding.confirmed: The request-local React cache wrapper was executed in the exact RSC auth boundary, but the A-B-A trace does not establish a repeatable performance effect.
finding.three_record_match: Not confirmed: B is not directionally better than both A runs across response time, RSC duration, auth_total, request-window count, and React commit signals.
finding.specificBoundary: app/src/lib/dashboard-server-auth.ts resolveDashboardAuth, called by dashboard layout/page and sibling dashboard pages
finding.auth_chain: auth_total spans remain present and variable; this experiment did not remove or coalesce the resolveAccountTenantContext chain across independent requests
finding.react_commit_cause: not confirmed; B commit counts and durations are mixed against A1 and A2
finding.request_fanout: not reduced with a stable repeated direction; the retained inbox projection remains the only confirmed contributing boundary
finding.db_lock: inconclusive; sampler is unavailable in all three runs and zero observed waits cannot establish lock absence

verification.selectedJ1Observations: PASS 6/6 valid and successful in A1, B, and A2
verification.sharedRuntimeHarnessTests: PASS 18/18 from the retained harness/checkpoint suite
verification.typecheck: PASS after serial rerun with baseline auth source restored
verification.productionBuild: PASS with both auth variants during the reversible toggle; final checkout is baseline auth

closure.runtimeState: React cache wrapper removed; uncached resolveDashboardAuth baseline restored. DashboardApp inbox filter projection remains retained for separate validation.
remainingWork: Keep the auth/session and RSC/bootstrap fan-out in scope; do not treat this cache candidate as a fix.
Repair or replace the Docker lock sampler before making a lock absence claim.
Validate the retained inbox projection at broader product level before any production-fix acceptance.
Do not change Plan 1 closure, Plan 2 eligibility, or production NO-GO from this evidence.
closure.nextAction: Define the next single-variable experiment around explicit request coalescing or auth-chain boundary ownership only after the sampler and selected journey validity are stable.
